name: Buncombe County & Western NC Regional Consortium
source_citation: Draft profile: goals summarized from public priorities. Page citations have not been verified against the official plan.
mission: To promote a healthy, safe, well-educated, and economically vibrant mountain community through sustainable stewardship and resilient rural infrastructure.

goals.title: Disaster Recovery, Slope Stabilization, and Mountain Flood Resilience
goals.citation: Buncombe & WNC Counties draft profile, goal 1
goals.description: Rebuild bridge, culvert, and steep-slope road infrastructure damaged by catastrophic mountain flooding, and install advanced flash-flood telemetry across mountain river basins.
objectives: Replace undersized mountain bridges with high-flow hydraulic spans
Stabilize debris-flow zones along rural secondary road corridors
Deploy streamflow gauges and early-warning warning sirens in French Broad and Swannanoa valleys

goals.title: Rural Water Systems, Mountain Wells, and Decentralized Wastewater
goals.citation: Buncombe & WNC Counties draft profile, goal 2
goals.description: Extend treated drinking water to rural mountain communities, remediate private well contaminants, and upgrade package wastewater plants to prevent mountain river degradation.
objectives: Interconnect rural mountain public water districts for emergency redundancy
Subsidize septic system repairs and decentralized wastewater treatment in karst/steep terrains
Protect high-elevation headwater streams from nonpoint runoff

goals.title: Rural Broadband, Telehealth, and Economic Diversification
goals.citation: Buncombe & WNC Counties draft profile, goal 3
goals.description: Close last-mile fiber gaps in remote hollows and mountain passes, expand telehealth connectivity for rural clinics, and support agricultural entrepreneurship and clean tourism.
objectives: Deploy last-mile aerial and underground fiber across unserved mountain ridges
Equip rural fire stations and community hubs with satellite backup connectivity
Support small mountain agricultural producers and value-added timber processing
